about_the_game:
Great Journey has what young players love most - storytelling and action- and adds loads of fun to a great adventure about a popular topic - ecology. Kids ages 6-12 will have hours of enjoyment learning about a subject they like, and enjoy the crisp and colorful graphics and "cool" action.

STORY
Tony "the Brave" is a 10-year-old-boy, very keen on travels, geography and adventures in general. One day he receives a postcard from his friend in Antarctica with a cry for help. Apparently something weird is going on in his land - an unknown individual is secretly throwing out dirty garbage onto a clean, white snow. The friend asks Tony to help him find out who the mystery character is and stop him, before the snow melts! Professor Glass, an eccentric genius may be able to help us with this important task, but well... we have to find him first. Don't wait - it's time to start a Great Journey!

KEY FEATURES
- Colorful and enchanting scenery.
- 5 chapters full of adventure and more than 30 locations from all over the world;
- Ecological theme with NO violence - promoting empathy and understanding the game is more than safe for your kid;
- Two speeds in the same game - storytelling of the slow-paces adventure side works just great with action and dynamics of mini-games;
- "One click" interface - our mouse based interface is extremely simple, for most of the time you click only one mouse button to perform various actions.
